evidence.reason: The finding asks to pin the child process cwd so `python -c` can import `crq`, `author_lease`, and `author_quota` regardless of the parent's working directory. The current tip already does exactly this: line 291 computes `here = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent)` and line 293 passes `cwd=here` to `subprocess.Popen`. The proposed fix is present, so the finding is no longer a defect. History attributes this to commit 20e6e335445e48b3e867be25562b2a6eaeb6d539 ("make three offline tests self-contained and non-flaky").
